threads.body: [General] This adds `27` to every matrix that uses `latestJava`, but `configureImage` only maps JDKs through 26 for Windows HotSpot, Linux HotSpot, and OpenJ9 (lines 302-334). Configuration therefore reaches the `Unexpected jdk version` branches while creating the servlet image tasks. Add pinned Java 27 images to all applicable mappings before selecting 27 here, or keep this matrix on 26.
threads.hunk:
@@ -27,7 +27,7 @@ gradle.sharedServices.registerIfAbsent("dockerBuildService", DockerBuildService:
 val extraTag = findProperty("extraTag")
   ?: java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd.HHmmSS").format(java.time.LocalDateTime.now())
 
-val latestJava = "26" // renovate(java-version)
+val latestJava = "27" // renovate(java-version)
